description: This file defines the FieldTypePluginManager class, which manages 'field type' plugins in Drupal, including creation of field instances, grouping definitions, and UI configurations.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Field\FieldTypePluginManager
classes.description: Manages field type plugins, including creation, grouping, and UI definitions.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates a new field item instance for a given field type with specified configuration.

methods.name: createFieldItemList
methods.description: Creates a list of field items for an entity's field.

methods.name: createFieldItem
methods.description: Creates a single field item at a specified index.

methods.name: processDefinition
methods.description: Processes and normalizes a plugin definition, setting default list class and category.

methods.name: getDefaultStorageSettings
methods.description: Retrieves default storage settings for a given field type.

methods.name: getDefaultFieldSettings
methods.description: Retrieves default field settings for a given field type.

methods.name: getStorageSettingsSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of storage settings for a field storage definition.

methods.name: getFieldSettingsSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of field settings for a field definition.

methods.name: getGroupedDefinitions
methods.description: Returns field type definitions grouped by category, sorted and normalized.

methods.name: getUiDefinitions
methods.description: Returns field type definitions available in the UI, including preconfigured options.

methods.name: getEntityTypeUiDefinitions
methods.description: Returns UI definitions for a specific entity type, allowing module alterations.

methods.name: getPreconfiguredOptions
methods.description: Retrieves preconfigured UI options for a specific field type.

methods.name: getPluginClass
methods.description: Returns the class name for a given field type plugin.
